newsitem.title: USA: St. Jude heart valve repair product approved.
newsitem.headline: St. Jude heart valve repair product approved.

text.p: St. Jude Medical Inc, a medical devices developer, said it has received U.S. Food and Drug Administration and Conformite Europeene Mark approval for a new heart valve repair product.

The SJM Seguin Annuloplasty Ring is a product that is used in patients whose heart valve disease can be managed through surgical repair procedures instead of the replacement of the heart valve, St. Jude which holds exclusive worldwide license to the SJM Seguin Annuloplasty Ring said.
Initial U.S. implants of the product have occurred at Duke University Medical Center in Durham, N.C., and Memorial Hospital, Colorado Springs, Colo., the company said.

The product has been available in selected European countries since mid-1996 and several hundred heart valve repair procedures have taken place using the product, involving both open chest and minimally invasive approaches, the company said.
St. Jude shares fell 1/4 to 36-1/8 Thursday.
